nodes.description: Address stored as the privileged owner of HodlerToken, set in the constructor from msg.sender and rewritable through setOwner.
uint256 burn percentage (default 1) used to compute the amount of tokens burned on every transfer/transferFrom.
uint256 counter of registered hodlers, used as write index into the hodlers mapping and as loop bound in _rewardHodlers.
uint256 hard cap of 1000e18 tokens used by _valueToMint and _rewardHodlers to limit minting.
mapping(uint256 => address) holding the enumerable list of hodler addresses iterated during rewards.
mapping(address => Hodler) tracking whether an address is already registered as a hodler.
Payable constructor that sets owner = msg.sender, mints 100e18 tokens to the owner and registers the owner as the first hodler.
Owner-only function that reassigns the owner state variable to an arbitrary address without any zero-address or sanity validation.
Overridden ERC20 transfer that burns a ratio of the value, registers the recipient as hodler and triggers _rewardHodlers.
Overridden ERC20 transferFrom that burns a ratio of the value from the sender allowance, registers the recipient and triggers _rewardHodlers.
Private function iterating all hodlers to redistribute newly minted tokens proportionally to their balances.
Public view returning the amount mintable per reward cycle (1e18 or the remaining supply).
Public view that uses inline assembly extcodesize to determine whether an address is a contract.
Caller-controlled address used as constructor owner, as the _onlyOwner guard subject, and as the from-address rewarded in transfers.
State write owner = _address in setOwner, guarded only by msg.sender == owner, allowing privilege transfer to an arbitrary or zero address.
super.burn(toBurn) call inside transfer that destroys tokens computed from the user-supplied value and burnRatio.
_mint(hodler, reward) inside the reward loop, minting tokens derived from a proportional division of toMint by totalBalance.
Unchecked subtraction maxSupply - totalSupply() used as the reward gating condition in _rewardHodlers.
Inline assembly extcodesize on an arbitrary address; returns 0 for contracts under construction, a known unreliable check.
super.burnFrom(_from, toBurn) inside transferFrom, deducting allowance and destroying tokens on behalf of another user.
Parameter _address of setOwner, written directly into the owner state variable.
Parameter _to of transfer, the recipient that may be registered as a new hodler.
Parameter _value of transfer, user-controlled amount split into burn and transferred value.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the account whose tokens and allowance are consumed.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the recipient that may be registered as hodler.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, user-controlled amount split into burn and transfer.
Parameter _from of _rewardHodlers, excluded from the reward distribution.
Parameter _to of _rewardHodlers, excluded from the reward distribution.
Parameter _address of isContract, passed into the extcodesize assembly block.
Local toBurn in transfer: _value.mul(burnRatio).div(100).
Local finalValue in transfer: _value.sub(toBurn) passed to super.transfer.
Local toBurn in transferFrom: _value.mul(burnRatio).div(100).
Local finalValue in transferFrom: _value.sub(toBurn) passed to super.transferFrom.
Local toMint in _rewardHodlers holding the per-cycle mintable amount.
Local totalBalance accumulating balances of eligible hodlers; used as divisor in the reward computation.
Local reward = toMint.mul(balance).div(totalBalance), the amount minted to each hodler.
Local balance of a hodler used to compute its proportional reward.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner inside the constructor, granting unrestricted privileged control to the deployer.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the _onlyOwner modifier guarding setOwner.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument to _rewardHodlers from transfer.
_msgSender() (msg.sender) is used as the allowance owner in transferFrom.
Constructor writes owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
setOwner body performs the owner assignment guarded only by the _onlyOwner modifier.
The unsafe assignment writes an arbitrary address into the owner state variable.
User-supplied _address flows directly into the owner state write.
_address is the sole parameter consumed by setOwner.
_value feeds toBurn = _value.mul(burnRatio).div(100).
burnRatio is multiplied into _value to compute toBurn.
toBurn is subtracted from _value to obtain finalValue.
_value feeds finalValue = _value.sub(toBurn).
finalValue is passed to super.transfer inside transfer.
transfer invokes super.burn(toBurn) after a successful transfer.
toBurn is the burn amount passed to super.burn.
transfer calls _rewardHodlers(msg.sender, _to) unconditionally after a successful transfer.
transfer reads addressToHodler[_to].exists to decide whether to register the recipient.
transfer increments totalHodlers when a new hodler is registered.
transfer writes the recipient into hodlers[totalHodlers].
_to is the recipient argument used by transfer.
_value feeds toBurn = _value.mul(burnRatio).div(100) in transferFrom.
burnRatio participates in the transferFrom burn computation.
toBurn is subtracted from _value to produce finalValue in transferFrom.
_value feeds finalValue = _value.sub(toBurn) in transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes super.burnFrom(_from, toBurn) deducting the caller allowance.
toBurn is the amount burned on behalf of _from.
transferFrom calls _rewardHodlers(_from, _to) after a successful transfer.
transferFrom reads addressToHodler[_to].exists for hodler registration.
transferFrom increments totalHodlers on new hodler registration.
transferFrom writes the new hodler into the hodlers mapping.
_from is the source account consumed by transferFrom.
_to is the recipient consumed by transferFrom.
_rewardHodlers evaluates the unchecked expression maxSupply - totalSupply() as its gating condition.
maxSupply is an operand of the unchecked remaining-supply subtraction.
_rewardHodlers calls _valueToMint() to determine the mintable amount.
The result of _valueToMint is stored in toMint.
_valueToMint return value flows into toMint.
hodlers[] entries are iterated to accumulate totalBalance.
totalHodlers is the loop bound of the reward accumulation loop.
_rewardHodlers accumulates totalBalance over eligible hodlers.
The per-hodler balance is a factor of reward = toMint.mul(balance).div(totalBalance).
toMint is multiplied by the holder balance to derive reward.
totalBalance is the divisor in the reward computation, reverting when it is zero.
_rewardHodlers computes the reward value for each hodler.
_rewardHodlers reads balanceOf(hodler) into the local balance variable.
The computed reward flows into _mint(hodler, reward).
_rewardHodlers calls _mint for every eligible hodler with a non-zero balance.
_from parameter is used as an exclusion filter in the reward loops.
_to parameter is used as an exclusion filter in the reward loops.
hodlers mapping is read inside _rewardHodlers to enumerate recipients.
totalHodlers bounds the reward loops in _rewardHodlers.
isContract executes the inline assembly extcodesize block.
_address is the argument examined by isContract.

_to is only used as an exclusion filter inside _rewardHodlers.
